# Social Baluni Public School (SBPS), Dehradun

> Premier CBSE co-educational English-medium school (Nursery to Class XII) located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, integrating holistic school education with competitive entrance preparation (NEET, JEE, NDA) and day boarding.

## School Overview
- **Name:** Social Baluni Public School (SBPS)
- **Affiliation:** Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi
- **CBSE Affiliation Number:** 3530479
- **CBSE School Code:** 81702
- **Founded:** 30 March 2014 under Mandakini Seva Samiti
- **Founding Heritage:** Backed by Social Group (Est. 1978), Polygon Group (Est. 1999), and Dr. Baluni Group of Education (Est. 1999).
- **Campus Address:** Haridwar Bypass Road, Brahmanwala, near Radhaswami Satsang Bhawan, Dehradun, Uttarakhand - 248001
- **Helpline Numbers:** +91 96900 00890, +91 96900 00895, 0135-2669696
- **Official Website:** https://www.sbpsdoon.com/

## Academic Architecture
- **Curriculum Stages:** Pre-Primary (Nursery, LKG, UKG via foundational play & XSEED pedagogy), Primary (Classes I–V), Middle School (Classes VI–VIII), Secondary (Classes IX–X), Senior Secondary (Classes XI–XII: Medical, Non-Medical, Commerce, Humanities).
- **Integrated Programme:** Schooling combined with competitive entrance foundation under one roof:
  - Medical Stream: NEET preparation in partnership with Baluni Classes.
  - Engineering Stream: JEE Main & Advanced preparation with computer-based test labs.
  - Defence Pathway: NDA and SSB interview mentorship with Doon Baluni Defence Academy.
  - NTSE & Olympiads: Foundation for young analytical minds starting in Class VI–VIII.
- **Day Boarding Facility:** Extended school hours (till 4:00 PM) including nutritious meals, supervised homework completion, remedial doubt clearance, and evening sports coaching.
- **House System:** Four river houses representing the sacred Himalayan rivers of Uttarakhand: Alaknanda (Azure Blue), Bhilangna (Emerald Green), Bhagirathi (Crimson Red), and Mandakini (Saffron Gold).
- **Sports Infrastructure:** 15+ disciplines including an indoor 10m shooting range, regulation boxing ring, 8-lane running track, cricket nets, football field, basketball courts, and badminton arena.
